notes: sanitizedWorldLevelName exists specifically to undo BDS's own habit of stripping '=' when it turns level-name into a folder name (comment lines 172-175), which matters for base64-encoded Realm exports whose names end in padding '='. Rule, in order: trim whitespace, return fallback if empty (line 170); split on the invalid set '/\\:\n\r\t=' (line 176-177); drop empty/whitespace-only pieces and join survivors with '-' (lines 178-181); trim '.' and ' ' off both ends of the joined result (line 182); return fallback if that's now empty (line 184). Case 1 shows the split-and-join producing a dash-joined name. Case 2 shows the up-front empty guard. Case 3 shows the realm-export '=' problem this function was written to fix: the trailing '==' produces two empty split components that get dropped, leaving a single un-dashed component. Case 4 shows an all-dots input surviving the split (no invalid chars present) but being reduced to empty by the trailing '. ' trim, falling back.
